# Baseline geography

## Load libraries
```{r}
# Set up renv for reproducible package management
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("renv")
} else {
  message("renv is already installed.")
}

# Load renv for environment management
library(renv)

# Activate renv if the environment is not synchronized
if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
  renv::activate()
}

# Restore the environment from lockfile (for reproducibility)
renv::restore()

# Load required libraries for spatial analysis and plotting
library(terra)      # Raster and vector spatial data
library(tidyterra)  # Tidyverse-style terra helpers
library(here)       # Relative file paths
library(viridis)    # Color palettes
library(readxl)     # Excel file reading
library(ggplot2)    # Data visualization
```

## Load data
```{r}
# Load processed spatial and facility data
# This script assumes that the required objects (Landcover, DEM, Facilities, OSM_roads, water_lines, etc.)
# have already been loaded by running '01.1_loading_processed_data.qmd'.
# If not, please run that file first to ensure all necessary data is available in the environment.
```

## Set the parameters for plotting
```{r}
# --- Define landcover color palette and class names ---
# Set up color mapping and class labels for each landcover code
landcover_colors <- c(
  "10" = "#006400",  # Tree cover
  "20" = "#ffbb22",  # Shrubland
  "30" = "#ffff4c",  # Grassland
  "40" = "#f096ff",  # Cropland
  "50" = "#fa0000",  # Built-up
  "60" = "#b4b4b4",  # Bare/sparse vegetation
  "70" = "#f0f0f0",  # Snow and Ice
  "80" = "#0064c8",  # Permanent water bodies
  "90" = "#0096a0",  # Herbaceous wetland
  "95" = "#00cf75",  # Mangroves
  "100" = "#fae6a0", # Moss and lichen
  "0" = NA           # No data
)

landcover_classes <- c(
  "10" = "Tree cover",
  "20" = "Shrubland",
  "30" = "Grassland",
  "40" = "Cropland",
  "50" = "Built-up",
  "60" = "Bare/Sparse vegetation",
  "70" = "Snow and Ice",
  "80" = "Permanent water bodies",
  "90" = "Herbaceous wetland",
  "95" = "Mangroves",
  "100" = "Moss and lichen",
  "0" = "No data"
)

# --- Filter landcover palette and classes to match raster values ---
# Only keep colors and classes for landcover codes present in the raster
unique_classes <- sort(unique(values(Landcover)))  # Get unique landcover codes present in raster

# Remove snow and ice if not present in study area
unique_classes <- unique_classes[unique_classes != 70]

filtered_landcover_colors <- landcover_colors[names(landcover_colors) %in% unique_classes]
filtered_landcover_classes <- landcover_classes[names(landcover_classes) %in% unique_classes]

# --- Generate terrain layers from DEM ---
# Calculate slope and aspect rasters from DEM for visualization
slope <- terrain(DEM, "slope")       # Slope raster
aspect <- terrain(DEM, "aspect")     # Aspect raster

# --- Create hillshade for visualization ---
# Simulate sunlight from NW direction for terrain shading
hillshade <- shade(slope, aspect, angle = 45, direction = 315)

# --- Filter facilities data into hospitals and health centres ---
# Subset facilities by type for plotting
facilities <- Facilities[[1]]  # Extract main facilities layer

hospitals <- facilities[facilities$Facility_t %in% c("National Referral Hospital", "Hospital", "Regional Referral Hospital"), ]
health_centres <- facilities[facilities$Facility_t %in% c("Health Centre III", "Health Centre II", "Health Centre IV"), ]

# --- Set plotting margins for legends ---
# Remove outer and inner margins for clean plotting
par(oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))

# --- Load complete landcover and facilities datasets for reference ---
# Load full landcover and facilities datasets for reference and alignment
landcover_complete <- rast(here("Data", "raw", "Landcover", "ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif"))
facilities_complete <- vect(here("Data", "raw", "Facilities", "suhsharan_health_facilities", "sub-saharan_health_facilities.shp"))

# --- Project and crop reference datasets to match analysis extent ---
# Align reference datasets to analysis CRS and extent
landcover_complete <- project(landcover_complete, Landcover)
ext(landcover_complete) <- ext(Landcover)

facilities_complete <- project(facilities_complete, Facilities[[1]])
facilities_complete <- project(facilities_complete, Facilities[[1]])
facilities_complete <- crop(facilities_complete, landcover_complete)

# --- Harmonize attribute names for joining ---
# Rename columns for consistent joining between datasets
names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == "Facility.n"] <- "Facility_n"
names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == "Facility.t"] <- "Facility_t"
names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == "LL.source"]  <- "LL_source"
names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == "Facility.n"] <- "Facility_n"
names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == "Facility.t"] <- "Facility_t"
names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == "LL.source"]  <- "LL_source"

# --- Extract coordinates from SpatVector objects ---
coords_c <- crds(facilities_complete)
coords_s <- crds(facilities)

# --- Match facilities by Facility_n ---
# Find common facility IDs and their indices in both datasets
ids_c <- facilities_complete$Facility_n
ids_s <- facilities$Facility_n

common_ids <- intersect(ids_c, ids_s)
idx_c <- match(common_ids, ids_c)
idx_s <- match(common_ids, ids_s)

# --- Compute mean coordinate offset ---
# Calculate average shift needed to align reference and analysis datasets (for unknown reasons they are slightly misaligned even after reprojection. We are aware of which datasource is more accurate but not why the misalignment occurs)
dx <- mean(coords_s[idx_s, 1] - coords_c[idx_c, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
dy <- mean(coords_s[idx_s, 2] - coords_c[idx_c, 2], na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Mean offset: dx =", dx, " dy =", dy, "\n")

# --- Apply coordinate shift to reference datasets ---
# Shift reference facilities and landcover to align with analysis datasets
facilities_complete <- shift(facilities_complete, dx, dy)
landcover_complete <- shift(landcover_complete, dx, dy)

# --- Split reference facilities into hospitals and health centers ---
# Subset shifted reference facilities by type for plotting
hospitals_complete <- facilities_complete[facilities_complete$`Facility_t` %in% c("National Referral Hospital", "Hospital", "Regional Referral Hospital"), ]
health_centers_complete <- facilities_complete[facilities_complete$`Facility_t` %in% c("Health Centre III", "Health Centre II", "Health Centre IV"), ]
```

```{r}
# --- Set output dimensions for PDF figure ---
# Convert width and height from millimetres to inches for PDF output
# A vector PDF is resolution-independent (equivalent to >600 dpi at any print size)
w <- 79.6  / 25.4  # 79.6 mm converted to inches
h <- 123.1 / 25.4  # 123.1 mm converted to inches

# --- Create PDF for baseline geography figure ---
pdf(here("Figures", "Pdf_final", "Figure_1_baseline_geography.pdf"),
    width       = w, height = h,
    version     = "1.4",      # needed for alpha transparency
    useDingbats = FALSE)

# --- Set plotting parameters ---
# cex = 8/12 gives ~8 pt at the device dpi, mai keeps zero outer margins
par(mai = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i", cex = 8/12)

# --- Plot reference landcover with transparency ---
plot(landcover_complete,
     col    = adjustcolor(filtered_landcover_colors, alpha.f = 0.15),
     legend = FALSE, axes = FALSE, box = FALSE)

# --- Overlay study area landcover with higher opacity ---
plot(Landcover,
     col    = adjustcolor(filtered_landcover_colors, alpha.f = 0.7),
     legend = FALSE, axes = FALSE, box = TRUE, add = TRUE)

# --- Add hillshade for terrain visualization ---
plot(hillshade,
     col    = gray.colors(100, start = 0.3, end = 1, alpha = 0.4),
     legend = FALSE, add = TRUE)

# --- Add infrastructure layers: roads and rivers ---
lines(OSM_roads,    col = "black", lwd = 0.7, lty = 1)
lines(water_lines,  col = "#1a6db5",  lwd = 0.7, lty = 1)

# --- Plot reference healthcare facilities (shifted for alignment) ---
points(hospitals_complete,      pch = 23,
       col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.5),
       bg  = adjustcolor("blue",  alpha.f = 0.4), cex = 1)

points(health_centers_complete, pch = 21,
       col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.5),
       bg  = adjustcolor("green", alpha.f = 0.4), cex = 1)

# --- Plot study area healthcare facilities ---
points(hospitals,      pch = 23, col = "black", bg = "blue",  cex = 1)
points(health_centres, pch = 21, col = "black", bg = "green", cex = 1)

# =============================================================
# LEGEND — two-column layout
#   Left  : Land cover classes
#   Right : Healthcare facilities + Transport & water
# =============================================================

lc_labs <- unname(filtered_landcover_classes)
lc_cols <- unname(filtered_landcover_colors)
n_lc    <- length(lc_labs)

cex_lgd   <- 6.5/12      # slightly smaller font
ysp       <- 0.75        # vertical spacing
inner_pad <- 0           # no extra inner horizontal pad (legend already has margin)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# LEFT COLUMN entries  (Land cover classes)
# Row 1 → blank (header: "Land cover classes")
# Rows 2..1+n_lc → land cover
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
left_labs  <- c("", "  Hospitals", "  Health centres",
                "", "  Major roads", "  Rivers / watercourses")
n_left     <- length(left_labs)

left_pch   <- c(NA, 23L, 21L, NA, NA, NA)
left_col   <- c(NA, "black", "black", NA, "black", "#1a6db5")
left_pt.bg <- c(NA, "blue", "green", NA, NA, NA)
left_lty   <- c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 1L, 1L)
left_lwd   <- c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 0.7, 0.7)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# RIGHT COLUMN entries  (Healthcare facilities + Transport & water)
# Row 1 → blank (header: "Healthcare facilities")
# Row 2 → Hospitals
# Row 3 → Health centres
# Row 4 → blank (header: "Transport & water")
# Row 5 → Roads
# Row 6 → Rivers / watercourses
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
right_labs  <- c("", paste0("  ", lc_labs))
n_right     <- length(right_labs)
lc_rows_r   <- seq(2L, 1L + n_lc)

right_pch   <- c(NA, rep(22L, n_lc))
right_col   <- c(NA, lc_cols)
right_pt.bg <- c(NA, lc_cols)
right_lty   <- rep(NA_integer_, n_right)
right_lwd   <- rep(NA_real_,    n_right)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dry-run both legends to capture their bounding boxes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
lgd_L_dry <- legend(x = 0, y = 0,
  legend    = right_labs, pch = right_pch,
  col       = right_col,  pt.bg = right_pt.bg,
  lty       = right_lty,  lwd = right_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.20, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n", plot = FALSE)

lgd_R_dry <- legend(x = 0, y = 0,
  legend    = left_labs,  pch = left_pch,
  col       = left_col,   pt.bg = left_pt.bg,
  lty       = left_lty,   lwd = left_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.25, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n", plot = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Anchor point: bottom-left of plot region + small inset
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
usr     <- par("usr")   # x1, x2, y1, y2
pad_x   <- 0.010 * (usr[2] - usr[1])
pad_y   <- 0.143 * (usr[4] - usr[3])   # preserve user's inset value
gap_col <- 0.05 * lgd_L_dry$rect$w     # minimal gap between columns

# Total box dimensions (no extra inner pad needed; legend() has its own margin)
box_w <- lgd_L_dry$rect$w + gap_col + lgd_R_dry$rect$w
box_h <- max(lgd_L_dry$rect$h, lgd_R_dry$rect$h)

# Bottom-left anchor (plot coord) for the outer box
box_x0 <- usr[1] + pad_x
box_y0 <- usr[3] + pad_y
box_x1 <- box_x0 + box_w
box_y1 <- box_y0 + box_h

# Draw white background box
rect(box_x0, box_y0, box_x1, box_y1,
     col = "white", border = "grey70", lwd = 0.5)

# x / y origin for each column (top-left corner of legend content)
x_L <- box_x0
y_L <- box_y1          # legend() places top-left at (x, y)

x_R <- box_x0 + lgd_L_dry$rect$w + gap_col
y_R <- box_y1

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Draw left legend — Land cover classes (no box)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
lgd_L <- legend(x = x_L, y = y_L,
  legend    = right_labs, pch = right_pch,
  col       = right_col,  pt.bg = right_pt.bg,
  lty       = right_lty,  lwd = right_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.20, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n")

# Overdraw left column section header (row 1: "Land cover classes")
text(x = lgd_L$text$x[1L], y = lgd_L$text$y[1L],
     labels = "Land cover classes", adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = cex_lgd, font = 2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Draw right legend — Healthcare facilities + Transport & water (no box)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
lgd_R <- legend(x = x_R, y = y_R,
  legend    = left_labs,  pch = left_pch,
  col       = left_col,   pt.bg = left_pt.bg,
  lty       = left_lty,   lwd = left_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.25, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n")

# Overdraw right column section headers (rows 1 and 4)
right_headers <- list(
  list(row = 1L, label = "Healthcare facilities"),
  list(row = 4L, label = "Transport & water")
)
for (h in right_headers) {
  text(x = lgd_R$text$x[h$row], y = lgd_R$text$y[h$row],
       labels = h$label, adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = cex_lgd, font = 2)
}

# --- Custom alternating scale bar (lower-right corner) ---
# Geography: 1 km = 1000 native map units (projected CRS, metres).
# Dimensions are anchored in device inches so the bar has a
# fixed physical size regardless of map extent.
usr   <- par("usr")                      # x1, x2, y1, y2 in map units
pin   <- par("pin")                      # plot region size in inches
uin_x <- (usr[2] - usr[1]) / pin[1]     # map units per inch (x)
uin_y <- (usr[4] - usr[3]) / pin[2]     # map units per inch (y)

# Physical bar design (in inches → converted to map units)
sb_len   <- 2000                         # total bar = 2 km (map units)
sb_half  <- 1000                         # midpoint  = 1 km
sb_h     <- 0.055 * uin_y               # bar height  ≈ 1.5 mm on paper
gap_x_in <- 0.15                         # right margin in inches
gap_y_in <- 0.70                         # bottom margin in inches (raised)

# Bar extent in map coordinates
sb_x2 <- usr[2] - gap_x_in * uin_x     # right edge
sb_x1 <- sb_x2 - sb_len                # left  edge
sb_xm <- sb_x1 + sb_half               # midpoint (1 km mark)
sb_y0 <- usr[3] + gap_y_in * uin_y     # bar bottom
sb_y1 <- sb_y0 + sb_h                  # bar top

# Two-segment fills (no per-segment border)
rect(sb_x1, sb_y0, sb_xm, sb_y1, col = "black",  border = NA)
rect(sb_xm, sb_y0, sb_x2, sb_y1, col = "grey88", border = NA)

# Outer border around the entire bar
rect(sb_x1, sb_y0, sb_x2, sb_y1, col = NA, border = "black", lwd = 0.7)

# Tick marks projecting above bar top (same height as bar)
tick_x <- c(sb_x1, sb_xm, sb_x2)
tick_h <- sb_h
segments(tick_x, rep(sb_y1, 3), tick_x, rep(sb_y1 + tick_h, 3),
         col = "black", lwd = 0.7)

# Numeric labels centred on ticks
lbl_y <- sb_y1 + tick_h + 0.018 * uin_y
text(tick_x, rep(lbl_y, 3), labels = c("0", "1", "2"),
     adj = c(0.5, 0), cex = 6/12, col = "black")

# "km" label right of "2", right-aligned visually
text(sb_x2 + 0.035 * uin_x, lbl_y,
     labels = "km", adj = c(0, 0), cex = 5.5/12, col = "black")

# --- North arrow ---
north(type = 2, cex = 8/12)

# --- Close PDF device ---
dev.off()
```
